status: pre-analysis protocol; exploratory retrospective audit, prospective competition starts on publication
scope: component inflation and explicit national CPI bridge if national components unavailable
horizon: monthly CPI through December 2027 and quarterly GDP through December 2027; no replacement of distant v3 forecasts
data_rules: archive downloaded bytes, URLs, timestamps and SHA256
latest vintage must never be labelled real-time vintage
use conservative publication lags for retrospective origins
no bank forecasts or economic overrides as model inputs
do not splice old/new ECOICOP without documented compatible series
inflation_candidates: headline random walk in year-on-year rates
headline seasonal monthly-price-change mean over last five available years
component seasonal and damped persistence forecasts, fixed equal weights
optional genuine TimesFM component forecast shown separately
gdp_candidates: ridge bridge using Polish industrial production, construction and real retail plus German production where available

audit.origins: monthly ninth-day origins 2015-2025 where data allow
audit.primary_loss: MAE of comparable CPI y/y monthly and GDP y/y quarterly targets
audit.selection_rule: publish fixed predeclared challenger; do not retrospectively claim it is a validated winner; negative results retained
audit.minimum_evidence_for_promotion: at least 5 percent MAE improvement overall and no >10 percent degradation in 2023-2025, plus no data-quality failures; promotion still provisional

uncertainty: empirical residual paths from mature historical origins, not arithmetic averages of marginal quantiles; no guarantee of nominal coverage
known_limitations: any TimesFM historical comparison can overlap model pretraining data
same-day retrospective protocol is not an untouched holdout
future basket weights unknown: last published weights held fixed and disclosed
